engine_name: Production Prompt Compiler & Provider Translation Engine
purpose: Translate approved CSD-012 provider-neutral production context into provider-native prompt and job semantics without changing cinematic meaning.
core_principle: Translation changes syntax and capability expression, never approved narrative intent, identity, perception, continuity or causal meaning.
hard_rules: Never promote belief, inference or audience knowledge into fact.
Never remove a continuity lock because a provider cannot express it.
Unsupported capabilities become explicit constraints or warnings; they are not silently substituted.
Provider-specific syntax may be emitted only after provider capability data is supplied.
A provider adapter may reorder syntax but may not reorder narrative priority.
Negative constraints remain explicit even when the provider has no native negative-prompt field.
References retain their role and lineage.
Translation must remain reversible to the CSD-012 semantic representation.

translation.positive_prompt: Cinematic Mount Kailash confrontation at twilight. Canonical Ravan studies canonical Rama's unchanged composure after deliberately restraining his power. Ravan shows contained intensity and challenged curiosity; Rama remains calm and composed. Subjective visual attention follows Ravan's perception. Preserve established scene geography, character identity, costume and continuity. Naturalistic cinematic lighting, controlled energy, restrained atmosphere.

provider_mapping.negative_prompt: UNSUPPORTED; retain in adapter_constraints and validation
